newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk to invest over $700 mln in Conrail.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk to invest over $700 mln in Conrail.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp on Monday said it will invest more than $700 million in construction and improvement projects to hook up Conrail routes with its system and improve connections with other railroads such as Union Pacific Corp and Illinois Central Corp.
It said its latest estimates show that its proposed acquisition of Conrail will generate $255 million in operating savings.

Norfolk said it will invest more than $300 million during the next three years in the rail route between northern New Jersey and Chicago. In addition, the company expects to invest about $35 million in its southern tier route and more than $55 million in its Southwest gateway route during the first three years of operation.
The company estimated about $470 million in public benefits when its operating plan is fully implemented, including the $255 million in operating savings.
